paragraphs.text: Sythis , also known as Harvest's Hand , is a Nyxborn nymph originating from the plane of Theros .

Sythis was brought into being by the god Karametra to guard the harvest and oversee the threshing of grain. Over time, however, Karametra's affection for Sythis grew so strong that she became more than just a caretaker—Sythis evolved into a trusted advisor and close companion to the goddess herself.

Karametra has granted Sythis a greater share of her divine power than any of her other servants, frequently referring to her as a "daughter." As Karametra's most potent representative on Theros, Sythis roams the land to carry out the god's will, ensuring the prosperity of the harvest and maintaining the balance of nature.
